statBlock.name: Star Spawn Hulk
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: This hulking servant usually guards a Star Spawn Seer. A seer can hit it with a Psychic Orb and let Psychic Mirror spread the damage to creatures near the hulk.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Psychic Mirror. If the hulk would take psychic damage, it takes none. Every creature within 10 ft. of it takes that damage instead. Magic can't reveal the hulk's thoughts or location.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If both hit the same target, it also takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of its next turn.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Reaping Arms (Recharge 5–6). Make a separate Slam attack against each creature within 10 ft. Each creature hit must make a DC 17 Dexterity save or fall prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 227.

statBlock.name: Star Spawn Larva Mage
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An emissary of an Elder Evil can fuse with a mortal cultist, replacing their personality. Its body breaks into a swarm of insects when defeated.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained.
sections.Traits: Return to Worms. At 0 hit points, the mage breaks apart into a Swarm of Insects in its space. It reforms from the swarm 24 hours later unless someone destroys the swarm first.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Slam or Eldritch Bolt attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.
Eldritch Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) force damage.
Plague of Worms (Recharge 6). Each creature within 10 ft., except star spawn, makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and the worms leave it blinded and restrained. It takes another 22 (5d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the mage's turns. At the end of each of its own turns, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion.
1/day. Dominate Monster.
sections.Reactions: Feed on Weakness. When a creature within 20 ft. of the mage fails a saving throw, the mage gains 10 temporary hit points.
sections.Legendary actions:
The mage has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can spend the listed cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. It must be able to act and, if surprised, must first finish its first turn.
Slam (1 action). Make one Slam attack.
Eldritch Bolt (2 actions). Make one Eldritch Bolt attack.
Feed (3 actions). Each creature restrained by Plague of Worms takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. The mage gains 6 temporary hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 228.

statBlock.name: Star Spawn Mangler
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Cultists use manglers as guards and assassins. They crawl across walls and crouch in shadows with four to eight long arms.

sections.Traits: Ambusher. The mangler rolls initiative with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the attack roll had advantage, the target also takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Flurry of Claws (Recharge 5–6). Make six Claw attacks. Before or after the attacks, the mangler can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 229.

statBlock.name: Star Spawn Seer
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A seer often leads a cult that seeks to bring an Elder Evil into the Material Plane. A Star Spawn Hulk makes both a bodyguard and a means of spreading the seer's psychic damage through Psychic Mirror.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Out-of-Phase Movement. Treat other creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. The seer's movement provokes no opportunity attacks. A creature the seer moves through takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage, at most once per turn from this trait. The seer takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Comet Staff or Psychic Orb attacks.
Comet Staff. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 19 Constitution save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Psychic Orb. Ranged spell attack, +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (5d10) psychic damage.
Collapse Distance (Recharge 6). Choose a creature the seer can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, teleport it and its worn and carried equipment up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the seer can see. Each creature within 10 ft. of the target's original space takes 39 (6d12) psychic damage. On a success, the target stays in place and takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.
sections.Reactions: Bend Space. When an attack roll would hit the seer, it can exchange places with another star spawn it can see within 60 ft. by teleporting with its equipment. The attack hits the other star spawn instead.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 230.

statBlock.name: Steel Predator
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An exiled modron in Sigil builds steel predators to hunt named targets. The machine uses an identifying object to fix on its prey. The predator tracks the target across planes to within 1,000 yards, then uses sight and smell to close in.

sections.Languages: Understands Modron and the language of its owner but can't speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Poison, psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The predator makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Unusual Nature. The predator needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) lightning damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d8 + 7) force damage.
Stunning Roar (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 33 (6d10) thunder damage, drops everything it holds, and is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success. On a successful initial save, it takes half damage and suffers no stun.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Wisdom. No spell components are required.
3/day each, self only. Dimension Door, Plane Shift.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 232.

statBlock.name: Stench Kow
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: These bison from the Lower Planes have orange and green hides and give off a toxic stench. A wizard may disguise one as an ox and loose it on a village.

sections.Traits: Stench. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the kow makes a DC 12 Constitution save. Stench kows are exempt. On a failure, the creature is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to the Stench of every stench kow for 1 hour.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the kow moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 72.

statBlock.name: Stone Cursed
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An alchemical rite animates a petrified Humanoid as a guardian. The rite uses basilisk blood and ashes from burned cockatrice feathers. It obeys the creator of the rite. An obsidian skull falls out when the guardian shatters, and the skull holds traces of the original victim's memories.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Traits:
Cunning Opportunist. The stone cursed makes opportunity attacks with advantage.
False Appearance. If it starts combat motionless, it rolls initiative with advantage. A creature that hasn't seen it move or act must pass a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to tell it apart from a statue.
Unusual Nature. The stone cursed needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Petrifying Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it starts turning to stone and is restrained until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. The effect ends on a success. On a failure, it is petrified for 24 hours.
sections.Cryptic Whispers mechanics: At the end of a short rest, a character can ask the obsidian skull a question aloud and make a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, the skull yields a memory that answers the question. The skull yields no further memories after the attempt, regardless of the result.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 233.
